messages:
Mira: Heads up — starting the critical window for static-serving v2 rollout. Plan: 3 waves (A/B/C) over the next 60m. Pin criteria: will pin if surge >= 5% error-rate or sustained p95 latency increase > 200ms.
Kevin: @deploybot kick off wave1 when ready.
deploybot: deploybot: starting rollout wave1 -> prod-group-A. Change window: 14:00-15:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-static-v2
Jordan: Copy. Can someone drop the backout/runbook links here? want the quick checklist in-thread.
Mira: Backout runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unwind-static-v2 — boiled-down checklist below:
```
1) run rollback job: `./scripts/rollback_shard --tag v1`
2) flush edge caches: `redis-cli -h cache-01 flushall`
3) unpin runtime: `deployctl unpin --service static-serving`
4) traffic shift: `trafficctl shift --to canary-pool --percent 100`
```
Kevin: Note: if latency spike >200ms for >5m, escalate to oncall @Sam and start fast-unpin steps.
Sam: Oncall here. If pinned, I'll do a fast-unpin + traffic-shift back to canary pool, then follow the full rollback checklist. Keep me in the thread and paste any alert ids.
Jordan: Are there any DB or schema toggles included in this release?
Mira: No DB migrations. Only model binary bump + runtime flag `enable_prefetch` flipping on.
deploybot: canary result: wave1 healthy (p95 latency unchanged). Deploying wave2 in ~10m. Live logs: https://logs.internal/app/12345 (tail).
Kevin: thumbs. Reminder: opsplay 'fast-unwind' at /runbooks/ops/fast-unwind matches this unpin pattern — follow that for service-level checks.
Sam: Abort procedure if needed: `deploybot abort <release-id>` then `deployctl pin --service static-serving --version v1` to force previous. Also run smoke checks after unpin.
Mira: Added backout snippet to the PR and linked runbook in the release notes. Monitoring for 30m after wave3 then finalize.
Jordan: I'll prep a postmortem template in case. ping me if any alerts or pager triggers.
deploybot: wave3 complete. No regressions detected. Finalizing release notes. :shipit:
Mira: Great job — saving the runbook links in the changelog and the incident playbook. If anything flips, reopen this thread. :thumbsup:
